about.metaDescription: How Lukka Place, Kinshasa's property listings platform, works.
about.title: A Platform Built for Kinshasa
about.lead: Agents and private owners submit their properties over WhatsApp. Every listing is structured, verified, then published.
about.body1: Lukka Place is a property listings platform dedicated to Kinshasa. Agents and private owners submit their properties directly over WhatsApp — text or photos — and every listing is structured and then verified before being published on the site.
about.body2: The aim is simple: to give people looking for an apartment, a villa or a plot in Kinshasa one single, up-to-date place where every listing corresponds to a property that is genuinely available — and a direct way to get in touch about a property, with no account and no form.
about.body3: Prices are set in US dollars. The Congolese franc display is an indicative estimate, converted at a dated reference rate that is updated manually, and is never presented as the contractual price.
about.body4: Lukka Place does not provide direct financial brokerage services; the platform facilitates introductions between advertisers and interested parties via listing reference.

matching.lead: Every customer request is ranked and pushed to the 7 best agencies in its commune, on WhatsApp, the second it is submitted.
matching.coverageGapBody: These customers described what they are looking for and nobody was notified — no registered agency covers their commune, or the request named none. It is the one metric on this page that shows where to recruit.
matching.rankingBody: plan, then weighted by its recent responsiveness and by how many requests it has already received, so that one commune's flow does not concentrate on a single agency.

matching.byAgentEmpty: No alert sent in this period.
matching.rankingExplained: Each agency is scored on its coverage of the commune (specialty 50 pts, coverage 20 pts), its real published listings in that commune (up to 25 pts), listings matching the requested budget and bedrooms (up to 15 pts) and a verified WhatsApp number (10 pts). The total is multiplied by its plan priority, then weighted by responsiveness and recent volume — that final figure is the score in the table.

marketData.title: Market Data
marketData.subtitle: Listed prices against the prices deals actually closed at, and why viewings fall through. Internal — do not publish.
marketData.noSourceHint: Closed before price provenance was recorded.
marketData.communeNote: An average is only shown from {min} transactions. Below that, only the real count is shown.
marketData.communeEmpty: No closed transaction with a price has been recorded yet.
marketData.transactionsEmpty: No closed transaction has been recorded yet.
marketData.declinesNote: Reasons given by the agent when declining a viewing, and by the customer when a viewing disappointed them.
marketData.declinesEmpty: No reason has been recorded yet.
marketData.closedHelp: Built only from listings an agent marked as sold or let with a real closing price — on WhatsApp after declining a viewing, or from their dashboard. Asking and closing prices are compared listing by listing. Nothing is estimated: a close with no recorded price is left out rather than filled in with the asking price.
marketData.communeHelp: Average gap between asking and closing price, per commune. Shown only once a commune has {min} closed transactions; below that only the real count appears, because an average of two sales is not a market figure.
marketData.transactionsHelp: One row per closed listing. The gap is computed when the page loads from the asking price and the recorded closing price; provenance says where the closing price came from.
marketData.publishedHelp: Computed live from every listing currently on the site (approved and visible). Rents are per month: a yearly rent is divided by 12, exactly as listing pages display it. Listings with no price ("price on request") are counted separately and never averaged in as $0. Rent and sale are never mixed.
marketData.publishedNote: What the market is asking today, by commune. Click a commune to narrow the distribution.
marketData.publishedEmpty: No priced listing is published for this transaction type yet.
marketData.lowSampleNote: Lighter bars have fewer than {min} listings — read them as indicative.
marketData.distributionHelp: How many published listings fall in each price band. Bands are fixed ranges in USD (per month for rent); the last band is open-ended.

telemetry.nudgeEmpty: No agent is sitting on a request.

telemetry.checkinEmpty: No viewing with a confirmed slot.
telemetry.conversionHelp: WhatsApp enquiries the engine received from a listing page's button, divided by taps that went to the central number. A tap routed to an agent's own WhatsApp never reaches us, so it cannot be part of the rate — it is shown separately underneath.
telemetry.conversionDirect: {count} taps went straight to agents (not trackable)
telemetry.trackedLeads: {count} tracked leads in total, including {visits} viewing requests
telemetry.topCommunesHelp: Ranked by WhatsApp taps recorded on listings in that commune, with the viewing requests received for the same commune beside them.
telemetry.topCommunesEmpty: No tap with a commune recorded in this period.
telemetry.deliveryHelp: The percentage is agency alerts the WhatsApp API accepted. Accepted is not delivered: Meta only delivers a session message to someone who wrote to us in the last 24 hours, and delivery receipts are not forwarded to us. An agent answering an alert is the one real proof it arrived.
